text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O often makes dramatic 
entrances. Even when it's just for 
ordinary training.

Will she appear dancing, or will she 
appear singing? While waiting and 
wondering which it'll be today—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Greetings, Trainer-kun! Good day to 
you!!"
It was an unexpected racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, captivated by my beauty, were you? I 
understand, I don't blame you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I ended up standing frozen before the 
mirror for a good two hours myself, you 
see...
choice_data_list: Why train in your racing outfit...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For everyone involved in the races, of 
course!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Wearing this outfit makes me far too 
dangerous... Just like a labyrinth that 
captures your gaze and never lets go."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trapped in a labyrinth, only to realize 
I've already crossed the finish line... 
This outfit risks causing such a tragedy 
for my fans.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then, what should we do? ...The answer is 
simple!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm giving them a chance to get used to 
seeing me like this! Before the race!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I am well aware this is an unfamiliar 
sight. For in this form, I am the 
culmination of the very concept of beauty 
across the world...!

"...Then setting aside the question of why 
I wore this in the first place."
choice_data_list:
You really like that racing outfit, don't 
you?
You must really like that racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's a wonderful outfit, 
perfectly suited for me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: For instance... over here, Trainer-kun!

Following TM Opera O, who had suddenly 
sprinted off—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“Ah...! Radiant gold ornaments, gleaming 
beneath the sun!”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh...! A cape fluttering gracefully in 
the wind!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Eternal beauty, the splendor of the world, 
the mystery of the cosmos...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The one who will captivate everyone and 
become the "Overlord of the End of the 
Century" is me!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What... What a perfect combination! This 
is a true revolution...! My legacy, 
forever engraved into the design 
industry...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The design of this racing attire is one 
thing, but the core concept behind it is 
simply magnificent! Truly, I am nothing 
short of brilliant...!"
choice_data_list:
You really went all out on the details, 
huh.

You really went all out on the details, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it is a well-known fact that 
everything looks good on me, but—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For these clothes, the theme was to find 
what suits the current me best out of 
everything.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do you know what that is?
choice_data_list:
The strength to live up to everyone's 
expectations

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! This cape, and these golden 
ornaments too! They are the throne for me, 
who keeps on running!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The gazes turned toward me as I race 
across the turf are not filled with awe 
for the strong... That's right!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...That is envy and admiration!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even if you close your eyes, you'll still 
see me behind your eyelids.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However! Even if you are brought to your 
knees by its brilliance, fear not. No 
matter who it may be, I will—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Take her hand and tell her, "Let us walk 
together!" Lead her to the stage befitting 
the "End-of-Century Overlord"!

Apparently, every single detail of the 
design was meticulously crafted. It was 
abundantly clear just how much passion 
T.M. Opera O had poured into it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-kun! You are yet another 
person who expects great things from me, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, if that's how everyone in the whole 
world is, then it was only natural...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I hereby declare that I will never betray 
those expectations!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"This outfit is, so to speak, my throne as 
I keep running! Let the masses gaze upon 
my beauty—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
They come to the G1 races, all seeking TM 
Opera O!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then I must welcome them with an even 
greater brilliance! That is—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because it's my duty as one who walks the 
"Path of the Overlord"!

Her burning passion comes through loud and 
clear. As her Trainer, I must do my best 
to grant her wish—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I know! I shall present you with an outfit 
worthy of standing by my side!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Neither the sun nor the moon can float 
without the sky. Therefore, you must turn 
your body into the sky! First, paint 
yourself sky blue all over—

"...I feel like leaving it to her any 
further would be dangerous. I should wrap 
up the conversation here for now."
